capabilities: create course records with exam dates and topic counts
generate structured topic notes with summaries, key concepts, and questions
run flashcard review sessions from Q/A pairs in notes
track per-course progress and days until exam in a sidebar
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to structure course study—tracking exam dates, topic mastery, and Q&A review requires manual setup.
summary: Study system that organizes courses and topic notes with flashcard-style Q&A review, practice questions, and per-course exam progress tracking.
